queries_run: CoreWeave CRWV path to profitability free cash flow positive timeline
CoreWeave guidance 2026 net loss adjusted operating income capex

findings.claim: Q2 2026 財報後管理層上調 2026 全年指引：營收 $12.4–13.2B、調整後營業利益 $960M–$1.15B；全年未給淨損或 FCF 轉正指引。
findings.source: MarketBeat, CoreWeave Q2 earnings call highlights (2026-08-11)
findings.excerpt: For the full year, CoreWeave raised revenue guidance to $12.4 billion to $13.2 billion and adjusted operating-income guidance to $960 million to $1.15 billion.

findings.source: MarketBeat, CoreWeave Q2 earnings call highlights (2026-08-11)
findings.excerpt: The company raised its full-year 2026 capital expenditure guidance to $35 billion to $39 billion, up from a prior range of $31 billion to $35 billion.

findings.claim: Q2 2026 調整後營業利益 $128M（5% 利潤率），淨損 $626M，利息費用 $640M；Q3 利息費用指引 $860–940M。管理層預期調整後營業利益率逐季擴張，Q4 達低十位數百分比（low-teens）。
findings.source: MarketBeat, CoreWeave Q2 earnings call highlights (2026-08-11)
findings.excerpt: Adjusted operating income was $128 million, a 5% margin. Net loss was $626 million, driven by $640 million interest expense due to increased debt.

findings.claim: 2025 年 FCF 約 -$7.25B（營運現金流 $3.1B、capex $10.3B）；『FCF 轉正』為第三方分析預期，非公司目標。
findings.source: DefiLlama dashboard, CRWV revenue streams and P/E

findings.claim: 2025 年底總債務約 $29.82B；管理層稱燒錢屬刻意前置、已鎖定約 300bp 較低借款成本，但有分析稱年度數字尚未印證。
findings.source: TIKR, CoreWeave's $640M interest bill is growing faster than its $128M profit
findings.excerpt: Management says CoreWeave front loads the burn by design and has already locked in nearly 300 basis points of lower borrowing costs

note: 未找到公司對 FCF/GAAP 轉正年度的明確指引；『2027 後期利潤率轉正』僅為分析師推測。第 4 條 as_of 與 excerpt 未能確認（頁面未讀）、第 5 條 as_of 為估計日；現金餘額/跑道未查到明確數字。
